enviarCorreio.heroDesc: A simple, step-by-step guide to packing and shipping your bouquet safely, so it reaches the atelier as beautiful as on the day of your ceremony.

enviarCorreio.materiaisAlt: Materials on a table for packing flowers: cardboard box, roll of tape, newspaper, scissors and pen.

passos.corpo: Dampen a few paper towels and wrap them around the stems. Then cover them with aluminium foil to hold the moisture in during the journey.
passos.nota: Never use cling film or plastic bags around the flowers: as they sweat, they can take on too much moisture and spoil.
passos.alt: Hands holding a bouquet with the stems wrapped in aluminium foil to retain moisture.

passos.corpo: Line the bottom of the box with scrunched-up paper or newspaper, forming a soft nest in the centre where the flowers will rest. Well-filled sides stop the bouquet from moving.
passos.alt: Open cardboard box lined with scrunched paper forming a central nest, with a FRAGILE label.

passos.corpo: Set the bouquet into the nest you prepared. Fill the spaces around it with more scrunched paper, gently, so the flowers stay firm in the box without being crushed.
passos.alt: Bouquet resting in the paper nest inside the cardboard box, ready to be shipped.

passos.corpo: If you would like to include a photograph, a note, the bouquet ribbon, your vows or anything else in the frame, place them in a sealed bag, against the side of the box and away from the flowers if possible. Also add a sheet with your name and a list of what is inside the box.
passos.alt: Sealed bag with a flower, a ribbon and a wedding-vows letter, beside the box.

passos.corpo: Seal the box well with tape so it cannot open in transit. Write FRAGILE and THIS WAY UP with an arrow pointing up. Send it by post or courier (CTT or a carrier), using an express service.
passos.nota: Shipping costs are the customer's responsibility.
passos.alt: Sealed cardboard box marked FRAGILE with a THIS WAY UP arrow pointing upwards.

faqItems.q: What does preserving a wedding bouquet actually mean?
faqItems.a: Preserving a wedding bouquet means turning the fresh flowers from your wedding into a piece that lasts for decades. At our studio we do it through botanical pressing: each flower is pressed and recomposed petal by petal, and the final composition is framed, and can be glazed with anti-UV museum glass. The frame holds the real flowers from your bouquet, not a replica.

faqItems.q: How can I hand in the bouquet?
faqItems.a: You can drop it off in person in Coimbra, send it by express courier, or request collection from a location by our team (subject to availability). We receive bouquets Monday to Sunday, including weekends.

faqItems.q: Do you receive bouquets from outside Coimbra? I'm in Porto / Lisbon / the Algarve.
faqItems.a: Yes. We receive bouquets from across mainland Portugal and the islands, and most of our clients are based outside Coimbra. The most convenient option is collection at a location of your choice by our team: we arrange the date and time with you and handle transport back to the studio. Alternatively, you can send the bouquet by express courier (CTT, MRW, DHL) with insurance. We regularly work with brides from Lisbon, Porto, Braga, the Algarve and Madeira.

faqItems.q: Do you receive bouquets at the weekend, including Sunday?
faqItems.a: Yes. We know most weddings take place on Saturdays or Sundays, so we are available at the weekend to receive your bouquet. You don't need to wait until Monday to contact us or make the handover.

faqItems.q: What is the maximum time to hand in the bouquet after the wedding?
faqItems.a: We accept bouquets up to 6 days after the ceremony, depending on the type of flowers. Ideally within 1 to 3 days: the fresher the bouquet, the more compositional options are available.

faqItems.q: How should I keep the bouquet until I hand it in?
faqItems.a: Place it in a vase with fresh water, away from heat and direct sunlight. Do not refrigerate it. If possible, trim the stems slightly before placing them in water.

faqItems.q: What else can I include in the frame?
faqItems.a: You can include the wedding invitation, handwritten vows, bouquet ribbons, a photograph, a piece of jewellery, a letter, or any meaningful element. Tell us what you have in mind and we will find a way to incorporate it.

faqItems.q: How long does the process take?
faqItems.a: Our average turnaround is around 6 months from when we receive the flowers to the finished framed piece. Pressing is a delicate process that cannot be rushed, and we never sacrifice quality for speed. When the composition is ready, you will receive photos by email and have 72 hours to approve or request changes.

faqItems.q: What are the prices and how does payment work?
faqItems.a: Prices start from €{quadro30x40}. See the options and pricing page for all available formats and finishes. Payment is made in three stages: 30% to book your date, 40% when we receive the flowers, and 30% on delivery.

faqItems.q: Do you ship outside Portugal?
faqItems.a: Yes. We ship worldwide: Spain, France, United Kingdom, Ireland, Italy, Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, Austria and Switzerland among many others, and also the United States, Canada and China. Shipping includes insurance and specialist packaging.

faqItems.q: Do you accept bouquets from international brides marrying in Portugal?
faqItems.a: Yes. We receive bouquets from brides of any nationality marrying in Portugal and ship the framed artwork to the bride's home country. We regularly work with Brazilian, Spanish, French, British and Irish brides.

privacidade.intro: At Flores à Beira-Rio, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights as the data subject.

sections.title: 2. Personal Data Collected
sections.content:
We may collect the following personal data, provided directly by you:
• Full name
• Email address
• Mobile number
• NIF (only if you request an invoice)

sections.title: 3. How We Collect Data
sections.content:
Your data may be collected through the following means:

sections.title: 4. Purposes of Processing
sections.content:
We use your data only for the following purposes:

• Issuing invoices, if requested

sections.title: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
sections.content:
Your data is not shared with third parties, except in the following cases:
• CTT (Portuguese postal service): only if you choose to receive your frame by post, and only with the data strictly necessary for delivery.
• Google Maps: only in the booking form, and only if you choose to have the flowers collected on site. Address suggestions are requested by our own servers, with no contact between your browser and Google. The confirmation map shown after you pick an address is loaded by Google directly in your browser, which means Google receives your IP address. If you would rather avoid this, you can type the address by hand without picking any suggestion.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: Data will be retained only for as long as necessary to provide the requested service and will be deleted once it is no longer needed for that purpose.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
• Access your personal data
• Request the rectification or deletion of your data
• Withdraw your consent at any time
• Object to the processing of your data
• Lodge a complaint with the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD)

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@floresabeirario.pt.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and Traffic Analytics
sections.content:
To improve the website and understand how it is used, we use traffic analytics tools:
• Umami: measures visits and page views in an aggregated, anonymous way. It does not use cookies or collect personal data.
• Microsoft Clarity: generates heatmaps and anonymous recordings of browsing (where people click and how far they scroll), so we can understand what works on the site. It uses cookies and the data is processed by Microsoft. Any text you type and form fields are automatically masked.
• Google reviews widget: may set third-party cookies.

We do not use this data to identify you individually or for advertising. You can object to this processing by contacting info@floresabeirario.pt or by blocking cookies in your browser.

termos.intro: By requesting a booking from Flores à Beira-Rio, the client declares having read, understood and accepted these Terms and Conditions. The version accepted is the one published on the date of the request. These Terms apply to the preservation of fresh flowers, the framing of dried flowers, bouquet recreation, and gift vouchers. Version 2.0.

sections.title: 1. Nature of the service
sections.content:
Flores à Beira-Rio preserves natural flowers by hand, through pressing and drying, turning flowers with emotional or symbolic value into personalised frames and pieces. We offer three services: preservation of fresh flowers, framing of already dried flowers, and recreation of bouquets with fresh flowers from photographs.
Every piece is unique and handmade in Coimbra. No two are alike. The nature of this process means the final result varies, which the client accepts when ordering. Small irregularities, textures and variations are part of the character of a handmade piece and are not considered defects.

sections.title: 2. Booking request, reply and confirmation
sections.content:
Filling in the form on the website is a booking request, not a confirmed booking. Places are limited, especially between May and September.
We normally reply within 3 working days with the quote confirmation and the deposit payment instructions. We prioritise requests by how close the event date is: someone with flowers to preserve this week is answered before someone booking for next year. So if your event is 6 months or more away, our reply may take longer than 3 working days. Your request is registered all the same.
The booking is only confirmed once the deposit is paid, within 24 hours of our message. Without payment in that time, the place becomes available to other clients again; the client may request a booking again later, subject to availability.

sections.title: 3. Quote
sections.content:
The summary shown in the form is an estimate calculated from the client's choices and the price list in force on the date of the request. The final quote is confirmed by us, by message, after reading the client's notes and special requests. Only that confirmed quote binds the parties.
The prices in force on the date of the request apply to that order, even if the price list is updated afterwards.
When the frame size, background or extras are left undecided at booking, the quote is provisional and uses the smallest frame as a reference. It is adjusted once the choices are made, usually at the composition stage, and the difference is requested with the next payment stage.
Not included in the quote: shipping the flowers to the studio, collecting the flowers at the venue (quoted separately, depending on distance) and shipping the finished frame to the client's address.

sections.title: 4. Payments
sections.content:
The service is paid in three stages, by bank transfer or MB WAY:
1st stage, 30%, at booking. It secures the place on the event date. Non-refundable.
2nd stage, 40%, when the flowers arrive at the studio. It is requested at that moment and must be paid within 5 days. Pressing starts immediately, because flowers cannot wait.
3rd stage, 30%, plus any adjustments, before the frame is shipped or picked up. The piece only leaves the studio after full payment.
Each payment comes with an invoice or receipt. Clients who want the document issued with a tax number must provide it before the respective payment.

sections.title: 5. Turnaround time
sections.content:
A preservation frame is ready, on average, around 6 months after the flowers arrive at the studio. Framing already dried flowers takes around 3 months when the original bouquet is used and around 6 months when there is recreation with fresh flowers.
This is an artisanal process, done by hand and without machines: pressing, drying and composition depend on the type of flowers, the season and the studio's workload. The timeline is therefore indicative and may extend. Orders with several pieces (extra frames, ornaments, pendants) may take longer.
The client follows every stage at status.floresabeirario.pt and is informed of any relevant delay. The indicative timeline is not a guaranteed date, and its extension does not give a right to a refund, discount or compensation.

sections.title: 6. Delivering the flowers to the studio
sections.content:
Flowers should reach the studio as fresh as possible: ideally 1 to 3 days after the event and at most 6 days. Until then, keep them in a vase with fresh water, away from sun and heat, and never in a fridge or freezer.
The client may drop them off in person in Coimbra, send them by post or courier (costs and choice of service borne by the client, following the packaging instructions we send) or request collection at the venue, subject to a quote and availability.
Transport to the studio is at the client's own expense and risk. We are not responsible for damage, delays or loss during shipping, nor for flowers that arrive wilted, mouldy or outside the recommended timeframe.
Flowers are always preserved in the condition in which they arrive. If they arrive decomposing, mouldy or otherwise unfit for preservation, we inform the client with photographs. We use everything we can from the original bouquet. If the client so decides, we buy similar replacement flowers, and that cost is borne by the client.
If nothing can be used and the client does not want replacement flowers, the deposit is not refunded, because the place was reserved and the condition of the flowers on arrival is the client's responsibility. The deposit may, however, be used towards a new order within 24 months.

sections.title: 7. Natural changes in the flowers
sections.content:
When pressed or dried, flowers change colour, shape and texture. Reds and burgundies tend to darken, whites turn cream or yellowish, pinks and purples lose intensity, greens turn brownish. Translucent areas or marks from bruising the flower already had may appear. Not all flowers withstand pressing: very fleshy flowers, succulents and some tropical flowers may not survive the process.
We do not colour-correct: the flowers keep the colour nature gives them once dried. Over the years, even with anti-UV glass, colours keep evolving slowly. All of this is natural, part of what a preserved flower is, and is not a defect nor grounds for a refund.

sections.title: 8. Flower selection and additional elements
sections.content:
Not every flower in a bouquet fits in a frame or survives in usable condition. We select those that best serve the composition, considering condition, thickness, frame size and the balance of the whole. The client may indicate flowers they would like included, without guarantee that it will be possible.
Additional elements the client wants in the frame (invitation, vows, ribbons, a photograph, jewellery, letters) must arrive together with the flowers, in a sealed bag, with a list of what is sent. They have no additional cost. Their inclusion depends on technical feasibility and available space. Items of material value (jewellery, medals) travel at the client's own risk.
Unused flowers and elements are not returned, unless the client requests it in writing when delivering the flowers. In that case they are kept until the finished piece is delivered.

sections.title: 9. Composition, approval and changes
sections.content:
Before gluing and sealing, we send the client photographs of the composition with the flowers laid out on the chosen background. The client has 72 hours to approve or request adjustments.
Reasonable adjustments to the layout (moving, swapping or removing elements) are included. Requests that mean redoing the composition from scratch, changing the background or frame size after approval, or several rounds of changes may carry an additional cost and extend the timeline, which we communicate before proceeding. The final composition may differ slightly from the photographs, because flowers settle differently when glued and sealed.
If there is no reply within 72 hours, we contact the client again. If after 30 days there is still no reply, we proceed with the proposed composition, so as not to block the studio or leave the flowers exposed. Once sealed, the piece cannot be changed.

sections.title: 10. Frames, glass and materials
sections.content:
Frames are handmade, with wood and conservation-grade materials. Being natural and made in small batches, the colour and grain of the wood may vary slightly between pieces and from the photographs on the website. If a chosen material becomes unavailable, we propose an equivalent alternative before proceeding.
Anti-UV museum glass is a paid option, chosen by the client at booking or up to the composition stage. Without it, the frame has standard glass. No glass fully prevents the natural evolution of colours over the years.

sections.title: 11. Delivery of the finished piece
sections.content:
The piece may be picked up in person in Coimbra or shipped by post or courier, with tracking, to the address given by the client. Shipping costs are borne by the client and are communicated before the 3rd payment stage. We ship worldwide; customs duties outside the European Union are borne by the recipient.
We pack every piece with care and the experience of many shipments. From the moment the piece is handed to the carrier, the risk of loss or damage passes to the client, as provided by law. At the client's request, and at additional cost, shipping can be insured.
The piece is only shipped or handed over after full payment. A finished piece whose final payment or pick-up does not happen within 6 months of our notice becomes available to Flores à Beira-Rio, with no refund of amounts paid.

sections.title: 12. Damage, complaints and warranty
sections.content:
If the piece arrives damaged, the client must contact us within 7 days of receipt, with photographs of the piece and the packaging, and keep the original packaging for the carrier's assessment. We resolve each case individually: repair, replacement of the frame or glass, or another agreed solution.
Pieces are covered by the legal consumer-goods warranty for manufacturing defects in the frame, glass and sealing. The natural changes in the flowers described in clause 7, normal wear, and damage from poor care (direct sun, humidity, heat, falls) are not covered.

sections.title: 13. Cancellations, rescheduling and refunds
sections.content:
By the client, before the flowers arrive: the deposit (1st stage) is non-refundable, because it reserves a place that was no longer available to others. If the event is postponed, the deposit may be transferred once to the new date, up to 24 months after the original date, subject to availability.
By the client, after the flowers arrive: stages already paid are non-refundable, because the work and materials have already been applied. What has not yet been paid is not requested, except for costs already incurred on client-specific materials (ordered frame, photo printing).
By Flores à Beira-Rio: if we cannot carry out the service for reasons attributable to us, we refund all amounts paid in full. If the flowers arrive unfit for preservation, clause 6 applies.

sections.title: 14. Right of withdrawal
sections.content: Flores à Beira-Rio frames and pieces are made to measure, with each client's flowers and choices. Therefore, under article 17(1)(c) of Portuguese Decree-Law 24/2014, the 14-day right of withdrawal for distance purchases does not apply. By paying the deposit, the client acknowledges that the service is personalised and that this right does not apply.

sections.title: 15. Gift vouchers
sections.content:
Gift vouchers are valid for 2 years from the date of issue and are intended for a preservation, framing or recreation order. The voucher amount is deducted from the quote. If the quote is higher, the beneficiary pays the difference in one go, when the booking is confirmed, instead of the three stages. If it is lower, the remainder may go towards extras in that order but is not refunded in cash. A voucher is not refundable or convertible into cash, and an expired voucher is not extended.
The voucher is credit: the preservation choices (size, background, extras, composition approval) belong to whoever makes the preservation booking with the voucher code, normally the recipient. sections.title: 16. Caring for the piece
sections.content: To last for decades, the piece should be kept away from direct sunlight, humidity (bathrooms, kitchens, cold walls) and heat sources. Clean the glass with a soft, dry cloth, without chemicals or sprays. The piece is delivered with care instructions, which form part of these Terms.

sections.title: 19. Liability
sections.content:
